exec: pm.test("status is uploaded or ai_read", () => pm.expect(["uploaded", "ai_read"]).to.include(j.status));
pm.test("400 for non-image (or 400 for no file)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

const h = pm.response.json().history; pm.test("history has step, time and staff", () => { const l = h[h.length - 1]; pm.expect(l.step).to.eql("approved"); pm.expect(l.at).to.exist; pm.expect(l.by).to.exist; });
pm.test("200 with a reply, or 503 when AI is not configured", () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));
